items.title: Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) Board Resignation Puts Governance Changes In Focus
items.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland (NYSE:ADM) announced that director Lei Z. Schlitz will resign from the Board following a voluntary material change in her principal employment. The resignation is effective at the end of the year and is not related to any disagreement with the company. ADM highlighted the governance aspect of the change as the Board prepares for an adjusted composition. Board changes like this at Archer-Daniels-Midland can prompt you to look more widely at other established companies...
